title: Boba Fett
description: Boba Fett, son and genetic copy of Jango Fett, was in the employ of Jabba the Hutt until Princess Leia Organa arrived. The princess slew the Hutt during Luke Skywalker's elaborate rescue attempt of Han Solo. After plunging into the Sarlacc Pit and then undergoing a period of rehabilitation with the Tusken Raiders, Boba Fett went on a quest to reclaim his armor and became Daimyo over Jabba the Hutt's old territory. He would ultimately trade his life of bounty hunting for one of responsibility. Legendary among the underworld, Boba Fett was renowned as a cunning warrior.
